conclusion: The missing seven Stage8 overlay chunks are real historical losses, but restoring them alone cannot restore the public API/base core because rocketdict.api was never part of that overlay contract.

The surviving Actions artifact inventory contains no direct recovered src/rocketdict/api/*.py member among the 96 scanned artifacts; the seven oversized nonexpired artifacts are structurally identified as Stanza or OPUS model/runtime supplies.
A documented older full checkpoint exists as a recovery lead, but its bytes are currently unavailable and its older version can only be treated as a base candidate.
The active recovery task is therefore to recover any full historical RocketDict checkpoint/core bytes and run rocketdict-recover-core before attempting any source-level compatibility reconstruction.
